note: Approved village map 21 Nov 2026. World coords metres: x east, z south. place.front = TRUE front unit vector (already corrected; game front = +z local). Existing places keep their 3D model: only position/rotation change. kind new_* = to be built. Existing places also carry "before" (their position and TRUE front in the running game on 9 Nov, read from the game), so each move = rotate by angle(before.front -> front) about the place, then translate before -> new. Source of truth for the map: artifact "Amrai Kheda map: proposed changes".
